notes: Source cells, English headings, data point counts and merged cells were extracted from the uploaded DOCX files.
WMF equation labels were visually decoded; the five Lissajous images are extracted original assets.
Formula cells ending in = preserve their labels and provide inline value fields.
Exp02 Hall effect and Exp05 holography are in the book contents, but no electronic tables for them were supplied.
Data tables-2017.docx includes bridge and ultrasound tables even though the supplied schedule omits those labs.
Exp14 final column spans are normalized to a consistent 8-voltage layout; original voltage sequence, including missing 26 V, is preserved.
